labor_rate_billed.wage_basis: BLS OEWS May 2024 janitor medians FL $15.16, GA $15.93, AL $14.00 vs national $17.27; SCA janitor (Polk Co. FL) $15.63 + $5.55 H&W
labor_rate_billed.loading: wage x ~1.30-1.35 burden (FICA, FUTA/SUTA, workers comp, GL) x ~1.5-1.7 overhead and profit = billed rate

meta.notes: Unit prices are starting points for an editable price book, not quotes. 'mid' is the typical FL/GA/AL bid price; low = competitive public-bid / large-volume level, high = small, rushed, high-access or heavily soiled work. rate_per_hr is units per worker-hour (not per crew). 'min' is a typical minimum charge for that line when bid alone. 'sourced' = a published price/bid anchor exists for this task or a direct equivalent; 'derived' = nearest sourced analog plus production-rate x billed-labor math. Lift rental, dumpsters, tipping fees, licensed-subcontract work and permits are excluded unless the basis says otherwise. Multiply by regional factor outside FL/GA/AL.
